text:
morgan: hey folks, running into a weird auth flow with `redwoodctl` on WSL2 — `redwoodctl login` prints 'Opening browser...' but Edge opens and nothing ever completes. CLI times out waiting for callback. Anyone seen this?

jade: yep — seen it when launching from tmux/ConEmu. Workaround is `redwoodctl login --headless` (device code flow) but that sucks for normal desktop dev. What shell/terminal?

morgan: Win11, WSL2 Ubuntu, launching from tmux inside VS Code remote. `redwoodctl` prints: "Opening browser to http://127.0.0.1:51234/callback" then after ~30s "Timed out waiting for callback". No browser console errors.

sam: probable culprit is our open routine. We call `powershell.exe Start-Process` from WSL which returns immediately and doesn't properly forward loopback URL back into the distro. We also don't detect WSL reliably.

jade: also related: `redwoodctl local test --profile staging` when run from Windows mounts `$HOME/.redwoodctl` into the container as root and `redwoodctl` inside container can't write tokens: `EACCES: permission denied, open '/home/dev/.redwoodctl/token'`.

morgan: exact repro for me — run localtest from WSL and then `redwoodctl login`. container logs show permission errors. I hacked a fix by running `docker exec -it <cid> chown 1000:1000 /home/dev/.redwoodctl` but that's not acceptable.

sam: breaking this into actionable items: 1) Add `--browser` flag to `redwoodctl login` (`--browser=auto|none|windows|xdg`) so we can force headless behavior. 2) If WSL detected (WSLENV/WSL_INTEROP or /proc/sys/kernel/osrelease contains "Microsoft"), auto-fallback to device-code after N seconds if callback not received. 3) In `local test` container mounts, chown mounted dir to container user UID at startup (or use named temp volume) and ensure `--profile` CLI flag takes precedence over mounted config.

jade: small repro steps for the permission issue: 
```
# from WSL
mkdir -p $HOME/.redwoodctl
docker run --rm -v $HOME/.redwoodctl:/home/dev/.redwoodctl:rw redwood/localtest:latest \
  sh -c "redwoodctl login"
# observe EACCES in container logs
```

ci-bot: issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/issues/3821 (labels: devex, cli, wsl) :information_source:

lee: another thing — CI reported `redwoodctl auth refresh` returns 500 when two processes refresh simultaneously. We should singleflight refresh and add jittered backoff to reduce races.

morgan: agree. Short-term doc idea: add CLI section "Auth in WSL and headless flows" to DevEx docs explaining `--headless`, env overrides (`REDWOODCTL_BROWSER`, `REDWOODCTL_HOME`), and how to run local test with proper volume mapping. I'll sketch it.

jade: test suggestion: unit test that simulates WSL by setting `WSL_INTEROP` and exercising login flow, and an integration test that mounts a host dir as root and validates `chown` path.

sam: I'll pick up the `--browser` flag + WSL fallback PR. branch: fix/cli-wsl-auth-fallback. Will add acceptance criteria in #3821.

morgan: thanks — appreciate it. If anyone can try the `--headless` device code flow and confirm it's workable for now, that'd help triage. :thumbsup:

jade: tried `--headless` and it works. Not perfect UX but unblocks local dev. :+1:

morgan: cool — marking this thread resolved for now until PR lands.
